name: laravel-gohu
description: Laravel Gohu is a VS Code extension that lets you run Eloquent and Query Builder queries directly against your application and get instant results in JSON format.

laravelTools.phpBinary.description: Path to the PHP binary used to run Artisan commands. Defaults to `php` from your PATH (works with Laravel Herd/Valet). On Windows + XAMPP set the full path, e.g. C:\\xampp\\php\\php.exe

laravelTools.nPlusOneThreshold.description: Number of times the same SQL query must repeat within a single run before it is flagged as a potential N+1 problem.

scripts.compile: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: pnpm run check-types && pnpm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: pnpm run compile-tests && pnpm run compile && pnpm run lint
